Definition: Baruk, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Baruch = "blessed"; 1) friend, amanuensis, and faithful attendant of Jeremiah; 2) a priest, the son of Zabbai who assisted Nehemiah in rebuilding the walls of Jerusalem; 3) a priest, or family of priests, who signed the covenant with Nehemiah; 4) son of Col-hozeh, a descendant of Perez or Pharez, the son of Judah
